entry_schema.title: Short factual title
entry_schema.category: Release | Characters | World | Community | Shopping | Guide
entry_schema.summary: Original concise summary, not copied article text

rules: Ranking score never overrides evidence status.
Official sources should outrank secondary reporting for official announcements.
Rumours must retain a rumour/theory label unless evidence changes.
Offers must show currency, region, source URL and last-checked timestamp.
Post-launch gameplay claims require reproducible evidence or a clearly attributed source.
